option_relations.rationale: Viral exanthem is a broader term that can encompass various skin eruptions, including erythema multiforme and Stevens-Johnson syndrome.

COVID-19-associated papulovesicular eruption with endotheliitis-like changes can be considered a subtype of viral exanthem, and its clinical presentation is similar to erythema multiforme and Stevens-Johnson syndrome.
COVID-19–related varicella-like exanthem is not directly related to the provided leaf IDs, as varicella zoster virus testing was negative.
COVID-19 with cutaneous manifestations is a broader term that can include various skin eruptions, including erythema multiforme and Stevens-Johnson syndrome.
